title: Detection of key mRNAs in liver tissue of hepatocellular carcinoma patients
author: Gholizadeh, Mazlooman, et al.

steps.title: Identify Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs)
steps.instruction: Identify DEGs from normalized log-expression levels in the integrated data using the Linear models for microarray data (LIMMA) R package based on the Bayesian technique.

substeps.instruction: Manage the false discovery rate using Benjamini-Hochberg's method.
Apply a p-value threshold of 0.05 for statistical significance.
Apply a fold-change cutoff of 1 (Log FC > 1).

steps.title: Develop Prognostic Risk Model
steps.instruction: Construct a prognostic model using the gene expression profile of GSE57957.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the model based on a linear combination of the regression coefficient derived from the Lasso Cox regression model coefficients multiplied by the mRNA expression level.

steps.title: Perform Survival Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze Overall Survival (OS) to compare differences between high- and low-expression groups.

substeps.instruction: Use the median as the cutoff value to divide patients into high-risk and low-risk groups based on the best performing threshold for OS.
Determine statistical significance using the Log-Rank test.
Evaluate results based on hazard ratios (HRs) > 1 or HRs < 1.
Visualize survival curves using the 'survminer' package.
Calculate survival probability at any particular time by dividing the number of subjects surviving (living minus died) by the number of subjects living at the start.
